# Test fixtures
All fixtures are synthetic and generated by `generate.mjs` (`npm run fixtures`): hand-built minimal PDFs with empty pages and a plain-text file. No third-party documents or images. Dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0.
Pending with the core module: encrypted PDF (generated by script, known provenance), damaged/bomb PDFs (fuzz), scripted annotation fixture (JS/Launch/widget/page /AA/URI), JPEG with GPS EXIF.
